        if stripped.startswith('namespace '):

        if namespace_seen and stripped == 'using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;':
            continue  # skip misplaced using inside namespace
        # Remove any existing UnconditionalSuppressMessage attributes
        if 'UnconditionalSuppressMessage' in stripped:
            continue
        cleaned_lines.append(line)

    # Now add "using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;" in the correct place (before namespace)
    if 'using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;' not in content:
        # Find the line just before "namespace" and insert there
        lines = content.split('\n')
        new_lines = []
        inserted = False
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            if not inserted and line.strip().startswith('namespace '):
                # Insert using before the blank line before namespace, or right before namespace
                # Look back for the last using directive
                insert_idx = len(new_lines)
                for j in range(len(new_lines) - 1, -1, -1):
                    if new_lines[j].strip().startswith('using ') and new_lines[j].strip().endswith(';'):
                        insert_idx = j + 1
                        break
                new_lines.insert(insert_idx, 'using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;')
                inserted = True
            new_lines.append(line)

    # Now add suppress attributes before the class declaration
    # Find first "public partial class" or "internal class" at 4-space indent
    pattern = r'^(    (?:public|internal) (?:partial )?class \S+)'
    match = re.search(pattern, content, re.MULTILINE)
    if match:
        pos = match.start()
        content = content[:pos] + suppress_attrs + content[pos:]
    else:
        print(f"WARNING: No class match in {filepath}")

    print(f"Updated: {filepath}")
